info.title: lucentAPI
info.description: An HTTPS API for lucentBASE, for lucentLIMS and any other client. **Authentication.** Send an access token from the OpenID Connect provider as `Authorization: Bearer `. The token's username has to belong to an active person in lucentBASE (`person.linux_user`); lucentBASE logs every change under that person. **Roles** come from lucentBASE (`j_person_role`), not from the token: `sampler` registers collections, `analyst` records raw values, `reviewer` accepts them (never their own: four-eyes principle), `admin` may do everything, including managing people and their roles. Reading needs no role. **Collections** have **values**, one per planned effect (an action's parameter), and values have **raw values**: the readings, each accepted on its own. A raw value's limits are the thresholds of its parameter in the documents of its action. **Audit trail.** lucentBASE's triggers log every change in `l_`, with the person and the `note` a request gives. **Concurrent changes.** Records that can be changed carry an `etag`. Send it in `If-Match`; if the record changed meanwhile, the answer is 412. **Errors** look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"?}}`. **Times** are UTC.
